hints.tr: `parts.hostname` küçük harfle ve `@`'dan sonraki gerçek ana bilgisayarı verir.
hints.en: `parts.hostname` gives the real host after `@`, in lower case.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def allowed(url, hosts):
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    return parts.scheme in ("http", "https") and parts.hostname in hosts

HOSTS = ["images.example.com"]
for url in ["https://images.example.com/cat.png",
            "http://127.0.0.1/admin",
            "https://images.example.com@127.0.0.1/",
            "file:///app/settings.ini"]:
    print(allowed(url, HOSTS))
```

The full solution:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def allowed(url, hosts):
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    return parts.scheme in ("http", "https") and parts.hostname in hosts

HOSTS = ["images.example.com"]
for url in ["https://images.example.com/cat.png",
            "http://127.0.0.1/admin",
            "https://images.example.com@127.0.0.1/",
            "file:///app/settings.ini"]:
    print(allowed(url, HOSTS))
```
